notes.title: [2024.10.28] Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Update Details:

1. The game now supports using the spacebar instead of mouse clicks.
2. Optimized some visual effects.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at efanjoy13@gmail.com.

notes.title: "Sewing Machine Simulator" has now been released!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow sewing enthusiasts!

Our game "Sewing Machine Simulator" is now on sale, with a 30% launch discount lasting for a week. We welcome everyone to come and experience it~
P.S.: Due to Steam restrictions, there are many game achievements, but we can currently only upload 100. When the restrictions are lifted after the release, we will upload the remaining achievements.

If you have any feedback, please feel free to contact us at efanjoy13@gmail.com!
